embeds.title: [Speedpaint] : N - Morimens (Fanart)
embeds.description:
N my beloved. When I first start to play Morimens, I was really expect to see how they gonna present Nyarlathotep, my beloved eldritch god. And when I saw him, it was like love at the first sight, he is the most perfect Nyarlathotep I have ever seen.

ที่รักของผมเอง ตอนที่เล่น Morimens ครั้...
